subject: Voyager 1
hook: VOYAGER 1 IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Voyager 1 is so far away that it is about to reach the milestone of being one "light-day" from Earth, meaning radio communications take a full 24 hours to travel in each direction.
angle_support: The spacecraft is approaching the one-light-day milestone, when radio signals will take 24 hours to travel between Earth and Voyager 1.
Voyager 1 is projected to reach a distance of one light day from Earth on November 18, 2026.
title: The True Distance of Voyager 1
description: Voyager 1 is pushing the boundaries of human exploration further than ever. It is about to reach a distance where light itself takes 24 hours to travel back to our planet.
narration: VOYAGER 1 IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a spacecraft buzzing through our local neighborhood. It was closer to home. In reality, Voyager 1 has traveled so far that space itself defies standard intuition. By November 2026, the probe reaches a historic milestone: one light-day from Earth. At this vast distance of sixteen billion miles, radio signals must travel for twenty-four hours in each direction to complete a single communication. Even light now takes an entire day to bridge the gap.
